name: Youjuu Club
source:
Assuming the role of a lecherous lesser demon you must uncover the background image with your marker until 80% of the image is revealed in a Xonix-like game.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
假设角色是一个好色的小恶魔，你必须用标记揭开背景图像，直到在Xonix类游戏中显示80% 的图像。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
